subject: Fix compatibility test suite (#1009)
reason: The change only modifies the project's own integration test suite (integration/compatibility/*, integration/compatibility_test.py) and .gitignore: it adds a sources-hash check for the pickle answer files, a regenerate.sh script, skips flaky tests, and regenerates the pickles. No module source code is touched, so the valkey-search module built at the change is behaviorally identical to the parent build; there is no runtime behaviour for a scenario to exercise or compare.
